source_caption:
🎥🎬: Rolling Loud The Movie (2026)

One father. One festival. One missing kid.

Owen Wilson stars as an overprotective dad whose attempt to bond with his 13-year-old son at Rolling Loud Miami takes a hilarious turn when his son disappears into the massive crowd. What follows is a chaotic race through the festival as he tries to track him down while getting caught up in the unpredictable world of Rolling Loud.

Starring Owen Wilson, Matt Rife and Christian Convery, with appearances from Travis Scott, Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla $ign, Ski Mask The Slump God and more.

🎬 In theaters October 2, 2026

source_details.synopsis: Rolling Loud: The Movie is a 2026 American comedy film written and directed by Jeremy Garelick. The film stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christine Ko, Christian Convery, Henry Winkler, and Jolene Blalock alongside musical guests such as Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla Sign, Ski Mask the Slump God, and Travis Scott.
